goal: Remove obsolete support for writing legacy un-XORed mempool dumps
Eliminates technical debt from a temporary fallback whose target releases are now end-of-life
Nodes keep the ability to read legacy mempool files on upgrade
agreement: Strong support for removing the temporary fallback for unsupported releases (maflcko, musaHaruna)
Objection on lost test coverage was resolved by adding explicit tests (maflcko)
Suggestion to clarify in release notes that reading legacy dumps remains supported (musaHaruna)

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because it is a routine cleanup removing an obsolete fallback option
